title: Template content envelope, version 1
description: What every content file of every template shares (Q64). A layout's file has `layout` and either `regions` (documents: regions of blocks) or `record` (applications: one record the layout's schema defines), never both; an application layout that shows only the shared record has neither. A template's shared file has `shared: true` and the regions every layout shares. Pure data: no markup, styles or code.

template.description: The template's id; must match the folder's manifest.

layout.description: The layout of the manifest this file is the content of.

shared.description: Holds the regions every layout of the template shares.

contentVersion.description: The content shape's version; must equal the manifest's `contentVersion`.

settings.description: Options of the layout component (for SiteLayout: which place is current, the column width); checked against the component's settings schema.

record.description: An application layout's data; checked against the template's `#/$defs/record.{layout}` (`record.shared` in the shared file).

type.description: A core block type (`hero`), or a template's own, namespaced (`conference.sponsor-wall`).
